sentences.en: No one can extinguish a light that shines from within.
sentences.zh: 没有人能熄灭内心发出的光芒。

sentences.en: Yanni had Skura roll on the ground to extinguish the fire.
sentences.zh: 亚尼让斯库拉在地上打滚以扑灭火苗。

sentences.en: The rain wasn't heavy enough to extinguish the fire.
sentences.zh: 雨水不够大，没能扑灭火苗。
